## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, what happened, and what the user can do after this change.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their result. For UI changes, include the real error/retry path and desktop/phone evidence. For source or evaluation changes, include the pinned versions, hashes, denominator and limits. Label checks that were not run.

## Evidence and data boundaries

State any change to source coverage, popularity, quality/rating semantics or usage reporting. Keep download, installation, observed reading and task outcome separate. Confirm that shared material is public/synthetic and that no credentials, private tasks, code, skill bodies or local paths were added.
